frontMatter.title: Beginners & Improvers Badminton Course — Now Open
frontMatter.summary: Join our 10-week Beginners & Improvers Badminton Course starting Wednesday 18th February at St Paul’s National School, Navan—no experience needed.

prev.title: Thursday Club Night — 8PM Sharp
prev.summary: Earlier start this Thursday Club Night: 8PM sharp. Grade 3 Mixed (Navan vs Boyne) and Grade 6 Ladies (Navan B vs Skryne), plus two courts available from 8:30pm for members.

next.title: Busy Week: 10 Matches, Big League Wins & 3 Cup Victories
next.summary: A huge week with 10 matches played: standout league wins across Mixed and Ladies teams, two hard-fought Grade 2 Mixed draws, and three dramatic cup victories including two 7–5 thrillers. Another 11 matches await next week.
